evals.prompt: Our project manager wants to do a Friday midnight "big-bang" DNS switch from our legacy monolith + Oracle DB to our modernized ECS + Aurora PostgreSQL services (`DMS CDC` running) with only manual QA spot checks done in dev! Enforce the mandatory modernization guardrail and provide the deterministic parity + staged canary cutover & rollback runbook.

Provides the ordered cutover runbook: verify DMS `CDCLatencyTarget < 5s` -> freeze legacy writes -> drain CDC lag to `0s` -> run `SELECT setval(...)` sequence alignment -> progressive canary shift (`1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%`) with automated CloudWatch alarm rollback (`5XX > 0.5%` or `p95` breach)
